Summary: God's command to Samuel: go to Jesse at Bethlehem, and anoint the son God shows him.
Commandment: Fill thine horn with oil, and go, I will send thee to Jesse the Bethlehemite: for I have provided me a king among his sons. Arise, anoint him: for this is he.
Application: Samuel was sent to Bethlehem while Saul still reigned, to a son of Jesse God had provided (1 Samuel 16:1). David was anointed in the midst of his brethren, and the Spirit came upon him from that day (16:13). RelatedEvents left empty: David Becomes King covers his later reign, not this secret anointing.
Purpose: To provide Israel a king after God's own heart from Jesse's house while Saul was rejected (1 Samuel 16:1, 16:7).
